expect: A Halloween evening in the MPH for every delegate, straight after the closing ceremony on Day two, with dinner afterwards. Programme TBC.

faq.question: Do I have to wear a costume?
What time does it start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 5:00 pm and finishes at 6:45 pm. Dinner follows until 7:30 pm.

faq.question: Can parents come?
faq.answer: No. Social Night is only for registered delegates, and delegates can't bring a guest.
